name: Arroyomolinos (Cáceres, Spain)
description: Blue field with a red triangle issuing from the hoist to the fly, charged towards the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Arroyomolinos (a mill, a cross of Saint James and a tree).
history: The arms and the flag of Arroyomolinos were approved by the Order of 2 March 1993 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 18 March 1993, approved by the Consejero de Presidencia y Trabajo Manuel Amigo after the municipal council's approval on 7 May 1991.
